details.description: Discover the timeless charm of RoohAfza, a beloved fruit-filled punch that has delighted generations for over a century. Introduced in 1907, this refreshing concoction is a perfect treat on a hot day, boasting an unparalleled flavour, fragrance, and colour. Crafted with a blend of herbal ingredients, RoohAfza is a thirst-quenching delight that can be enjoyed in a variety of ways. Mix it with water for a refreshing beverage, add it to milk for a creamy treat, or use it as a topping for desserts and mocktails. The key ingredient, rose petals, lend their cooling properties and soothing effects, making RoohAfza an ideal choice for those seeking a natural way to beat the heat. Rich in vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants, this vegetarian-friendly drink not only quenches your thirst but also nourishes your body, maintaining and adjusting your water levels. Truly a versatile and delightful addition to any occasion, RoohAfza is a timeless classic that continues to captivate taste buds and hearts alike.

details.description:
Established in 1906 by Hakeem Hafiz Abdul Majeed, Hamdard is known for his purity and has been a trusted name for over a hundred years. To live up to that trust, we use only the purest ingredients ethically sourced from across the globe. And we blend them with the purest of intentions to give you the best taste and nutrition possible. From the same house, we bring you Hamdard Olive Pomace Oil straight from Spain. The healthy fats in Olives are extracted to produce Olive Oil, an instrumental component of an incredibly healthy diet. Hamdard Olive Pomace Oil has a high heat tolerance, without losing nutrients, which makes it perfect for everyday Indian cooking. Having a high smoking point makes it ideal for deep frying also. Hamdard Olive Pomace Oil is an amalgamation of Refined Olive Pomace Oil and Virgin Olive Oil which gives it a neutral taste and brings out the real taste in food.
Hamdard Olive Pomace Oil contains:
High mono-unsaturated fatty acids, which help in lowering cholesterol
Antioxidants that promote good heart health
Vitamin E for good immunity
Vitamin K for better bone density and health Hamdard Olive Pomace Oil is available in a 1 L bottle. The carton contains twelve bottles.
